string-array.name: whats_new_bullets
string-array.item:
• Added Nghe Epub TTS as a read-aloud engine with manual model import
• Added Waka Toolkit reader fonts, Bookerly, and Waka background image themes
• Fixed EPUB reader dark mode so the page switches to a dark background with light text
• Improved read-aloud sentence splitting and Nghe Epub TTS speed handling

• New \"Progress\" screen in the navigation menu: reading time by day/week/month/year, day streak with a record, a customizable daily reading goal, week-over-week trend, translation frequency, and estimated reading speed\n• Reading time here is tracked across your whole library and stays even if a book is later removed or edited

• More accurate sentence highlighting while using Read Aloud
• Sleep timer now fades the volume out smoothly before stopping playback
• Added a preview button to hear a voice sample before choosing it in the voice picker
• Various reliability improvements to audio playback

• Book descriptions with formatting now display properly instead of showing raw HTML tags\n• Publish date and last-updated date now show for Google Drive library books\n• \"Local tags\" button on the book preview page replaced with \"Share\"
• Fixed downloading books from the Calibre Content Server browser — tapping Download now saves the book correctly, matching OPDS and Google Drive
• Device Library and Calibre Library no longer jump back to the top of the list when returning from a book preview
• Added a \"What\'s New\" screen (replacing \"About\") in the navigation drawer\n• Added a new \"Exit\" button to fully close the app

• Fixed a bug where editing a book's metadata could get silently overwritten by the next library sync
• Added full editing support for Custom Columns from Calibre Desktop
• Custom Column values now appear on the book detail screen (toggle in Settings)
• "Get metadata from ebook" now also imports Custom Columns from EPUB files
• Sort by: added Series, Rating, Publisher, Publish Date, File Size\n• Filter by: added Series, Publisher, Rating, and any Custom Column\n• Works on both Device Library and Calibre Library

• Publisher, Publish Date, Series, Rating, Languages, Identifiers, Date Added and File Size are now saved for every book instead of being dropped during sync\n• Lays the groundwork for full Custom Column support
• New \"Scan QR\" button next to \"+ Add another library\" to add a Calibre-on-Google-Drive library\n• Fully on-device scanning, no extra sign-in required
• Internal app package renamed\n• Cloud accounts may need to be reconnected once after updating
• New Settings switch to hide the title and reading progress in Grid view, for a cleaner cover-only look
• New \"Sort by...\" button next to \"Filter by...\", with Ascending/Descending toggle, on both Device Library and Calibre Library

• Tapping a connected cloud account now shows library info and a "Sync now" button
• Renaming books no longer creates duplicate uploads to cloud storage
• Unchanged files are skipped on sync, and large files upload more reliably
• Fixed background read-aloud audio stopping unexpectedly when switching apps
• Added a "+" button to manually import books into the Device Library
• New pronunciation dictionary lets you define how names and words are read aloud, for more natural text-to-speech
• Fixed a blank screen when the Calibre server can\'t be reached\n• Now shows a retry option and your saved Google Drive libraries instead
• Reader Settings redesigned into one tabbed panel (Font / Layout / Color / Actions / Read Aloud)\n• Google Drive library browser upgraded for faster browsing
